title: Rossouw Farming Group concedes United Exports rights over OZblu varieties
summary: Reports that a settlement and interim licence were reached on 17 November 2020 between United Exports and the Rossouw Farming Group, with the dispute over removal of the plants referred to arbitration.
why_it_matters: Gives the outcome of the enforcement action from a source outside the rights holder. A settlement with an interim licence is a different outcome from a court ruling on the merits, and the distinction should not be lost.

reading.rationale: Records the outcome rather than the allegation.

commercial_position.rationale: Shows how such disputes resolve in practice.
